title: Console header and recent list re-translate an overridden report or page label with the base package's translation, over the server's answer
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfgvGexKn9vLHsy89K

Filing gate: ③ the Studio finding of #30193 (PR #30236), carried as a follow-up so the spec PR stays in scope; contract review 6648581045, should-fix 3. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p2, because once #30062's server half lands, a customer who renamed an installed package's report or page in its `.custom` override sees the new name in Studio and the old translated name in the Console header. Route: `domain:ui`.

**What a user sees.** A customer overrides an installed package's report (or page, dashboard, app) in its `.custom` package and gives it a new label. The server now answers the label by the ruled order of #30193 (the pair's own translation, then the override's own text, then the base's translation). Studio shows that answer. The Console header crumb, the app's report index and the recent-items list show the base package's translation of the old label instead.

**Why.** At origin/main, `ui/packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts:489` `reportLabel` (and `:482` `pageLabel`; the dashboard and app label helpers have the same shape) looks up the catalog key first and takes the served label only as the fallback, so it re-applies the base's translation over the label the server already translated. Callers: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx:750` (the report crumb), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/appReportIndex.ts:324`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useRecentItemLabel.ts:122`. Studio's rails read served `/meta` text (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/servedNavText.ts`) and are already right.

## Wanted

- [ ] For a served report, page, dashboard and app document, take the served `label` as already translated; use the catalog key only when no served label is at hand.
- [ ] A test per helper: an overridden item whose served label differs from the base's translation shows the served label in the header crumb, the report index and the recent list.

Blocked-by: #30062
Part-of: #30193
